reviewedTables.legacyNeed: NAICS-coded career department rows that also preserve defensible joins for businesses.cdepts_id and grade_cs.cdepts_id.
reviewedTables.reason: Puerto Rico CBP sources can provide observed NAICS values, but they do not define career departments or preserve the legacy joins to businesses and grade_cs.

candidateFindings.finding: Useful for distinct Puerto Rico NAICS values, but not a source for career-department semantics.
Provides CIP, SOC, NAICS, and career-cluster crosswalk context, but it is not Puerto Rico-specific row evidence and does not recover legacy cdepts joins.

reviewedTables.legacyNeed: Business title, physical address, point coordinates, and a defensible join to cdepts.
reviewedTables.reason: No confirmed Puerto Rico-only public source supplies business title, physical address, point coordinates, and a defensible cdepts/NAICS join for the preserved legacy table.

candidateFindings.finding: Official registry context exists, but no documented bulk open-data feed, stable API, point coordinates, or NAICS/cdepts join was confirmed.

Federal registrant data can include addresses and NAICS, but it requires an API key, is not Puerto Rico business-location coverage, lacks point coordinates, and includes contact fields that require minimization.
Puerto Rico-filtered POIs can provide coordinates, but coverage is crowdsourced, tag-based, non-NAICS, and carries ODbL obligations for redistributed derived databases.

reviewedTables.legacyNeed: University-to-career-department rate by year, joined through unis.id and cdepts.id.
reviewedTables.reason: No confirmed Puerto Rico-only source provides university-to-NAICS or career-department rate by year; education datasets are CIP-based adjacent sources and would require non-source-backed crosswalk assumptions.

candidateFindings.finding: IPEDS provides postsecondary data and completions analysis, but not a NAICS/cdepts graduation or career rate for the preserved legacy table.
Field-of-study data is CIP-based and useful context, but does not provide a source-backed NAICS/cdepts rate.
Crosswalk context can support future research, but using it to synthesize grade_cs rows would blur source facts with inferred modeling.

nextSteps: Keep cdepts, businesses, and grade_cs blocked in the registry, schema map, and provenance confidence contracts.
Search for an original organizer-provided dataset or documented Puerto Rico-only bulk source before implementing imports for these tables.
If adjacent education or business sources are used later, model them in new planning-specific contracts instead of forcing them into the preserved legacy tables.
